title: MORABO loveseat
description: MORABO loveseat, Grann/Bomstad golden brown/wood Warm and welcoming, neat and stylish. The supporting seat cushions, the cover’s soft finish and the tight fit gives this sofa a perfect balance between its comfort, functions and look. Removable armrests make it easy to add on a chaise lounge.
features: The seat cushions, back cushions and inside, top, front of the armrests are covered with GRANN – a soft, smooth and strong grain leather with natural variations. Other surfaces have the coated fabric BOMSTAD.
materialAndCare: Back and seat frame: Plywood, Solid pine, Particleboard, Fiberboard; Armrest frame: Plywood, Solid pine, Polyurethane foam 1.5 lb/cu.ft., Particleboard, Fiberboard; Back cushion: Polyurethane foam 1.5 lb/cu.ft.; Seat cushion: High-resilience polyurethane foam (cold foam) 2.2 lb/cu.ft.; Smolder resistant lining: Polyester wadding; Leather: Dyed through top-grain leather with a treated, embossed and pigmented surface; Coated fabric parts: 100 % polyurethane, 75 % polyester, 25 % cotton; Solid wood, Oak veneer, Clear lacquer
